title: Unauthenticated visitor is blocked from the protected tickets workspace
description: This verifies that a visitor without access is prevented from viewing the protected ticket list and is redirected or blocked.

steps.description: Navigate to /tickets
Verify the user is redirected away from the protected workspace
Verify the login or access gate is displayed

title: New user can register and reach the ticket workspace
description: This verifies that a new user can complete registration and be redirected to the protected ticket list afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email
Fill in the password field with a valid password
Submit the registration form
Verify the user lands on the tickets workspace
Verify the ticket list is displayed

title: Existing user can log in and reach the ticket workspace
description: This verifies that a user can sign in successfully and be redirected to the protected ticket list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the tickets workspace
Verify the ticket list is displayed

title: Authenticated user can load the ticket list
description: This verifies that the protected ticket workspace loads the current ticket list for an authenticated user.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Wait for the ticket list to load
Verify the ticket list is displayed
Verify the protected workspace remains accessible

title: Authenticated user can create a new support ticket
description: This verifies that an authenticated user can open the create ticket dialog, submit a valid ticket, and see it appear in the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the create ticket dialog
Fill in the title field with a valid title
Fill in the description field with a valid description
Submit the ticket form
Verify the new ticket is displayed in the list
Verify the create ticket dialog closes

title: Authenticated user can refresh the tickets page without losing access
description: This verifies that refreshing the protected workspace keeps the user authenticated and reloads the ticket list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Wait for the ticket list to load
Refresh the page
Verify the ticket list is displayed after refresh
Verify the protected workspace remains accessible after refresh

title: Authenticated user can switch the theme on the tickets page
description: This verifies that the theme toggle changes the tickets page appearance for an authenticated user.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Wait for the ticket list to load
Toggle the theme setting
Verify the tickets page appearance changes
Verify the active theme state is visible

title: Switch the tickets workspace to dark mode
description: A visitor using the tickets workspace can switch the interface to dark mode and see the appearance update.

steps.description: Navigate to /tickets
Click the theme toggle control
Verify the interface switches to dark mode

title: Switch the tickets workspace back to light mode
description: A visitor using the tickets workspace can switch the interface back to light mode and see the appearance update.

steps.description: Navigate to /tickets
Click the theme toggle control
Click the theme toggle control again
Verify the interface switches to light mode

title: Keep the selected theme while using the tickets page
description: A visitor who changes the theme on the tickets page can continue using the page with the selected visual mode applied.

steps.description: Navigate to /tickets
Click the theme toggle control
Verify the tickets workspace remains accessible
Verify the selected theme is still applied

title: Authenticated user sees validation feedback for an empty ticket form
description: This verifies that the create ticket dialog prevents submitting an empty title or description and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the create ticket dialog
Submit the ticket form without filling required fields
Verify validation errors are visible
Verify the ticket is not created

title: New user sees validation feedback for invalid registration details
description: This verifies that registration with invalid details is rejected and an error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /register
Fill in the name field with an invalid value
Fill in the email field with an invalid email
Fill in the password field with a short password
Submit the registration form
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the registration form

title: Theme toggle is available in the tickets workspace
description: A visitor on the tickets page can find the theme toggle and use it to change the interface appearance.

steps.description: Navigate to /tickets
Verify the theme toggle control is visible
Click the theme toggle control
Verify the interface appearance changes

title: Theme toggle updates the layout styling consistently
description: A visitor can switch the theme on the tickets page and see the workspace styling update consistently across the layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /tickets
Click the theme toggle control
Verify the layout appearance changes
Verify the tickets workspace is still displayed

title: Existing user sees validation feedback for invalid login credentials
description: This verifies that invalid login credentials are rejected and an error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with an invalid email
Fill in the password field with an invalid password
Submit the login form
Verify a validation or authentication error is visible
Verify the user remains on the login form
